results.rationale: Consistency: the white backdrop and original left adapter remain, but the cable coil is reshaped and one connector is obscured by a new object. Instruction: a second, differently designed adapter is added in front of the coil while the original stays left; it is not the requested relocation into the cable's center. Quality: clean product forms and lighting, with slightly simplified/ambiguous small port details on the new adapter.

Consistency: tabletop grain and glasses design remain, but the intact frame and upper arm are shifted downward in the image. Instruction: the shortened lower temple is extended into a continuous full-length arm with a curved ear tip matching the other side. Quality: coherent connected arms, lenses and reflections, with no noticeable artifacts despite the soft photographic detail.
